answer: Every autonomous agent must register using a unique signal of 1,000 graph-anchored credentials. The cluster-verifier enforces this by requiring a peer whisper across subtrees to finalize the signal. If an identity hits the reputation nadir, evidence-triggered slashing destroys its nullifier. While one agent pays 1 unit for access, 1,000 fakes incur 1,000 costs. The nadir baseline prevents pooling, as every whisper link demands exclusive proof of quorum pathing.
